abort.already_configured: This Tion Lite is already configured.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect. Make sure Tion Lite is in pairing mode, the Tion Remote app is closed, and the Home Assistant Bluetooth adapter can see the device. The detailed reason was written to the Home Assistant log.
error.invalid_address: Enter the MAC address as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.

progress.connecting: Home Assistant first creates the system Bluetooth bond, then reconnects and reads the Tion Lite state. After the beep, wait a few seconds and keep this window open.
progress.scanning: Searching for nearby Tion Lite devices. The scan takes about 10 seconds.

bluetooth_confirm.description: Prepare {name}: put the breezer in standby, then hold the Heating/Pairing button for 5 seconds. Close the Tion Remote app and select Submit.
bluetooth_confirm.title: Connect Tion Lite

connection_error.description: Home Assistant reached the breezer but could not finish pairing or data exchange. Put the breezer into pairing mode again before retrying. Technical reason: `{error}`
connection_error.title: Tion Lite connection failed

manual.description: Enter the MAC address shown in Tion Remote as AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF.
manual.title: Enter MAC address

no_devices.description: No Tion Lite devices were found during the 10-second scan. Make sure the breezer is powered, nearby, and not connected to Tion Remote. You can scan again or enter its MAC address manually.
no_devices.title: No breezers found

scan_result.description: Found Tion devices: {count}. You can select a breezer, scan again, or enter a MAC address manually.
scan_result.title: Bluetooth scan complete

select.description: Select your Tion Lite. The list shows its name, MAC address, and RSSI signal level. An RSSI value closer to zero means a stronger signal.
select.title: Select Tion Lite
